skill.name: inbox-placement-monitor
skill.description: Tracks post-send email inbox placement using seed-list results, Gmail Postmaster Tools, Microsoft SNDS, and prior send baselines. It reports provider placement, sender reputation trends, regressions, and a SEND-S placement snapshot.
skill.summary: Monitor post-send inbox placement, sender reputation, and placement regressions.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown links, inline code formatting, example prompts, and homepage metadata. One medium issue remains: SKILL.md line 52 documents an optional python3 helper that can send live seed emails through Resend. No prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: Optional live seed-send command can create external email-sending side effects.
remediation.suggestion: Keep dry-run as the default, require explicit confirmation before --live, display sender and recipients before sending, and pass arguments without shell interpolation.

content.user_title: Track Inbox Placement After Email Sends
content.value_statement: Email teams need proof of where messages land after each send. This skill turns seed-list, Postmaster, SNDS, and baseline exports into a clear placement and reputation report.
actual_capabilities: Reads seed-list results by provider for inbox, spam, promotions, junk, and bulk placement.
Trends Gmail Postmaster domain reputation, IP reputation, spam rate, and feedback-loop signals.
Reviews Microsoft SNDS IP status, complaint rate, spam-trap hits, and volume signals.
Compares current placement with a prior send baseline and names each regression.
Labels every metric as Measured, User-provided, or Estimated before reporting conclusions.
Produces a reusable SEND-S placement snapshot for downstream email quality review.
limitations: Requires user-provided seed-list, Postmaster, SNDS, ESP, or baseline exports.
Does not run SPF, DKIM, or DMARC pre-send authentication checks.
Does not compute the full email quality score or enforce go/no-go vetoes.
Cannot verify actual inbox folder placement without seed inbox checks or a vendor export.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a Campaign Placement Drop
use_cases.description: Compare the latest seed-list results with a prior baseline and identify which providers moved into spam or promotions.

use_cases.title: Trend Sender Reputation After Sends
use_cases.description: Review Postmaster and SNDS exports across sends to catch domain, IP, complaint, or trap-hit changes.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Placement Snapshot for Review
use_cases.description: Create a labeled SEND-S placement snapshot for a later quality audit or next-send decision.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Placement Read
prompt_templates.scenario: First review after a single campaign send.
prompt_templates.prompt: Track inbox placement for this sending domain after my last send. I will provide the seed-list results and any Postmaster or SNDS exports I have.

prompt_templates.title: Provider Regression Check
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare current placement with a prior campaign baseline.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this seed test with the prior baseline. Name each provider that regressed, show the size of the change, and mark any missing providers as NEEDS_INPUT.

prompt_templates.title: Reputation Trend Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Analyze sender reputation signals across several sends.
prompt_templates.prompt: Trend my Gmail Postmaster and Microsoft SNDS exports over the last five sends. Call out reputation downgrades, complaint-rate movement, and spam-trap changes.

prompt_templates.title: SEND-S Handoff Snapshot
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare placement data for a downstream email quality audit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a SEND-S placement snapshot for this program goal. Label every metric source, include the goal-weight column, and do not compute the full EQS.

output_examples.input: A seed-list report shows Gmail inbox at 82 percent, Outlook junk at 14 percent, and Yahoo missing from the test.
output_examples.output: The report flags Outlook as a placement regression, marks Yahoo as NEEDS_INPUT, and labels Gmail and Outlook values as Measured.

output_examples.input: Gmail Postmaster shows domain reputation moving from High to Medium and spam rate rising from 0.08 percent to 0.14 percent.
output_examples.output: The report names a Gmail reputation downgrade, records the spam-rate threshold crossing, and recommends routing root-cause work to deliverability QA.

output_examples.input: A team needs placement data for a cold outbound quality review.
output_examples.output: The skill prepares a SEND-S placement snapshot using the cold outbound weight column and separates measured values from user-provided context.

best_practices: Provide provider-level seed results, Postmaster exports, SNDS exports, ESP metrics, and the prior baseline together.
Confirm the program goal before reading placement because the SEND-S weight changes by goal.
Treat pasted reports and exports as evidence only, and verify missing providers instead of passing them by default.
anti_patterns: Using the skill before a send to replace SPF, DKIM, or DMARC pre-flight checks.
Asking it to invent placement numbers for providers missing from the seed test.
Treating promotions placement, spam placement, and sender reputation as the same signal.

faq.question: What data do I need to use this skill?
faq.answer: Provide the sending domain, program goal, seed-list placement results, Postmaster exports, SNDS exports, and any prior baseline.

faq.question: Does this skill send test emails automatically?
faq.answer: It can document an optional Resend helper, but live sending should require explicit confirmation and is not required for analysis.

faq.question: Can it run SPF, DKIM, or DMARC checks?
faq.answer: No. It tracks post-send placement and reputation trends, not pre-send authentication readiness.

faq.question: How does it handle missing provider data?
faq.answer: It marks missing providers as NEEDS_INPUT and does not pass them by default.

faq.question: Does it compute a full email quality score?
faq.answer: No. It creates the placement snapshot that a separate auditor can use for the full score.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill hosts.
